concerns.text: FR-003 mandates a frozen Llama-3-8B/Mistral-7B; the tasks unilaterally substitute pythia-410m/TinyLlama-1.1B as the primary model. The plan permits TinyLlama only as a 'strict memory fallback', not as the default. This is a semantic weakening of FR-003 made in the task layer without a spec/plan amendment; the deviation must be recorded as a documented requirement change (spec amendment) or the task must attempt the specified model first with the small model as the documented fallback.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs spec.md:FR-002 and constitution Principle VI
concerns.text: FR-002 requires static analysis with 'CodeQL and tree-sitter'; T003 states 'CodeQL is optional and may be dropped if the CLI is unavailable on the runner — tree-sitter metrics alone satisfy FR-002's labels.' No spec or plan clause authorizes dropping CodeQL; Principle VI also names both tools. Either amend the spec or make CodeQL a required attempt with a documented, loud-failure fallback path.

FR-005 requires threshold detection 'controlling for token frequency and n-gram probability.' T007 fits piecewise/linear models on repository aggregates with no covariate control; the confounder control appears only in T005's correlation step. The threshold half of FR-005 is uncovered as written.

Two contract violations in T004: (a) it claims output 'per code_chunk.schema.yaml' but writes flat fields while the schema mandates nested static_labels/inference_metrics/metadata with additionalProperties:false and a required baseline_model; (b) FR-010 and the schema describe division-based normalization by n-gram probability, but T004 computes subtraction (per_token_loss − ngram_logprob_per_token). Either fix the task or amend the contract/spec.

T002 writes raw chunks with only id, repo_name, language, content, status but claims conformance to dataset.schema.yaml, whose required fields include cyclomatic_complexity, nesting_depth, per_token_loss, token_count. The download-stage artifact can never validate against the schema it names; either reference a raw-ingest schema or restructure.

data-model.md mandates Parquet (snappy) for all intermediate and final artifacts; every task writes JSONL. Reconcile the format (amend data-model.md or switch tasks) so the contract survives into execution.

FR-011 says the system MUST validate against a human-labeled benchmark; T010 (following plan.md's fallback) permits skipping with a limitation report. The plan documents this staging, but the spec FR was never amended — make the fallback explicit in spec.md FR-011 so the task is not silently weakening a MUST.
